links.comparator_used: Preferences for chatbot transcripts without context-aware nudges (baseline preference, in which a majority rejected guideline-aligned, norm-divergent advice)
links.outcome: User preference for transcripts containing guideline-aligned advice (expectation alignment)
links.effect: Nudges shifted preferences towards guideline-aligned transcripts; the abstract gives no numbers for the shift (a majority of the 200 participants rejected such advice at baseline).
links.quote: Through the design and introduction of context-aware nudges, we support expectation alignment that shifts preferences towards transcripts containing guideline-aligned advice.

design_hint: context-aware nudges for expectation alignment in chatbot advice
